symptom.note: Saved a bill with an empty second name and the bill page crashed.
symptom.console_error: Unhandled rejection: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')

root_cause.summary: initials() called toUpperCase on undefined for a blank person name, crashing the bill view.

proposed_lessons.text: Never edit tip.js, money.js or split.js to fix a bill.js view crash: the fix stays in views/bill.js, and /bill/9 tip-total diffs from the change-tip flow are mid-flow timing (5% vs 10% snapshot), not fix side effects.
